label: Exact negation of the selected-whole-causer…, from A candidate edge to the selected whole…
meaning: An actual candidate edge plus absence of every existing causer contradicts selected-whole-causer actuality. This excludes the remainder when that independently supplied intended policy holds.

strong_version_needed.516be275-934a-59e1-bbb2-02fc3b57a936: The proof uses both conjuncts: h.1 (HasSomeCause) supplies the candidate causer c, and h.2 (NoExistingCause) is then contradicted. The weak version NoExistingCause (ce2ca4eb) is only the second conjunct and supplies no causer.
